0022600121.text: The Celtics, 1-1 overall and 1-0 at home, sit 3rd in the Atlantic and 6th in the East, while the Bulls, also 1-1 and 1-1 on the road, are 2nd in the Central and 7th in the East. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Boston won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 124-105 home win on Feb. 11, 2026. Boston is missing Devin Carter (illness), and Chicago is without Nic Claxton (hamstring), Noa Essengue (head, bruise) and Patrick Williams (groin, soreness).
